backend.input: Crie um endpoint POST /api/v1/users com validação de email usando Express, Zod e JWT. Inclua tratamento de erro estruturado.
backend.description: Backend should generate Express endpoint with Zod validation and JWT

frontend.input: Crie um componente React de formulário de login com validação de email e senha, usando hooks. Mostre mensagens de erro.
frontend.description: Frontend should generate React component with form handling and validation

api-architect.input: Design uma API REST para um sistema de e-commerce. Inclua resources para produtos, pedidos e usuários. Mostre endpoints, métodos HTTP e status codes.
api-architect.description: API Architect should define REST resources with HTTP methods and status codes

qa-architect.input: Descreva uma estratégia de testes para uma API de autenticação. Inclua unit tests, integration tests, e security tests.
qa-architect.description: QA Architect should define test strategy with multiple test types

devops.input: Configure a CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions. Include build, test, and deploy stages. Deploy to Docker and push to a registry.
devops.description: DevOps should define GitHub Actions workflow with build/test/deploy stages
